instagram.caption:
How to respond to Google reviews: 2 replies for plumbing, roofing and HVAC business owners.
In a study of TripAdvisor hotel reviews, hotels that started replying got 12% more reviews, and their ratings rose 0.12 stars on average (Proserpio and Zervas, Marketing Science 2017). It's a hotel study, not trades, so treat the numbers as a guide.

Reviews Clinic, Lesson 7: copy these.
Good review: "Thanks, [first name]. Glad the [job] went well. We're here when you need us. [Your name]"
Bad review: "Sorry we fell short on [issue]. I want to make it right. Call me directly at [number]. [Your name]"
Name the real problem. Don't argue in public.

Once hotels replied, bad reviews got fewer but longer: more detail you can act on.

Send this to whoever runs your Google profile.
Do you answer every review, or only the bad ones? Tell me what you write. I'll rewrite a few in a future lesson.
Free tools for trade owners: link in bio.
Narrated by an AI version of my own voice.

youtube.title: How to Respond to Google Reviews: 2 Replies to Copy (Plumbing, Roofing, HVAC)
youtube.description:
How to respond to Google reviews: one reply for a good review, one for a bad one.
For plumbing, roofing, HVAC and home service business owners.
Proserpio and Zervas, "Online Reputation Management: Estimating the Impact of Management Responses on Consumer Reviews," Marketing Science 36(5), 2017: when hotels started responding to reviews, they got 12% more reviews and their ratings rose by an average of 0.12 stars (INFORMS release, Sept 8, 2017, on tens of thousands of TripAdvisor hotel reviews). Responding hotels also got fewer but longer negative reviews. This is a hotel study, not a trades study, so treat the numbers as a guide.

Copy these:
1. Good review: "Thanks, [first name]. Glad the [job] went well. We're here when you need us. [Your name]"
2. Bad review: "Sorry we fell short on [issue]. I want to make it right. Call me directly at [number]. [Your name]" Name the real problem. Don't argue in public.

Good or bad, answer every review in your own words. Send this to whoever runs your Google profile.
Next lesson: another Reviews Clinic fix.

Narrated by an AI version of my own voice.
